chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon him), regarding:

If a man dies while his wife is under his guardianship, but he has not yet consummated the marriage with her, he said: She receives half of the dowry, and she inherits fully, and upon her is the complete waiting period.
ai.seo_question: What are the rights of a wife if her husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the jurisprudential status of a wife in the 'pre-consummation' phase, establishing that while she receives only half the dowry, she retains full inheritance rights and the complete three-month 'iddah. This ruling is significant in Shia fiqh as it distinguishes the financial and temporal obligations of the wife based on the physical consummation of the marriage contract rather than mere cohabitation.
